#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> multiply(const vector<int>& p1, const vector<int>& p2, int mod) {
    int len1 = p1.size(), len2 = p2.size();
    int resultLen = len1 + len2 - 1;
    int fftSize = 1;
    while (fftSize < resultLen) fftSize <<= 1;

    vector<double> re1(fftSize, 0.0), im1(fftSize, 0.0);
    vector<double> re2(fftSize, 0.0), im2(fftSize, 0.0);

    for (int i = 0; i < len1; i++) {
        long long val = ((long long)p1[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        re1[i] = val & 0x7fff;
        im1[i] = val >> 15;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < len2; i++) {
        long long val = ((long long)p2[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        re2[i] = val & 0x7fff;
        im2[i] = val >> 15;
    }

    fft(re1, im1, false);
    fft(re2, im2, false);

    vector<double> prodRe(fftSize), prodIm(fftSize);
    vector<double> extraRe(fftSize), extraIm(fftSize);

    double scale = 0.25 / fftSize;
    for (int i = 0; i < fftSize; i++) {
        int j = (fftSize - i) & (fftSize - 1);

        double a1r = (re1[i] + re1[j]) * 0.5;
        double a1i = (im1[i] - im1[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2r = (im1[i] + im1[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2i = (re1[j] - re1[i]) * 0.5;

        double b1r = (re2[i] + re2[j]) * 0.5;
        double b1i = (im2[i] - im2[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (im2[i] + im2[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (re2[j] - re2[i]) * 0.5;

        prodRe[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        prodIm[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        extraRe[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        extraIm[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    fft(prodRe, prodIm, true);
    fft(extraRe, extraIm, true);

    vector<int> output(resultLen);
    for (int i = 0; i < resultLen; i++) {
        long long part1 = llround(prodRe[i]);
        long long part2 = llround(extraRe[i]);
        long long part3 = llround(prodIm[i]);
        output[i] = (int)((part1 + ((part2 % mod) << 15) + ((part3 % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return output;
}

void fft(vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
    int n = re.size();
    int bits = 32 - __builtin_clz(n);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = __builtin_reversebits((unsigned)i) >> (32 - bits);
        if (i < j) {
            double temp = re[i]; re[i] = re[j]; re[j] = temp;
            temp = im[i]; im[i] = im[j]; im[j] = temp;
        }
    }

    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int half = len >> 1;
        vector<double> cosines(half);
        vector<double> sines(half);
        double angle = 2 * M_PI / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            cosines[i] = cos(i * angle);
            sines[i] = sin(i * angle);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                double cr = cosines[j];
                double ci = sines[j];
                double ur = re[i + j];
                double ui = im[i + j];
                double vr = re[i + j + half] * cr - im[i + j + half] * ci;
                double vi = re[i + j + half] * ci + im[i + j + half] * cr;

                re[i + j] = ur + vr;
                im[i + j] = ui + vi;
                re[i + j + half] = ur - vr;
                im[i + j + half] = ui - vi;
            }
        }
    }

    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            re[i] /= n;
            im[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

class InputReader {
private:
    istream& inStream;
    char buffer[1024];
    int ptr, length;

public:
    InputReader(istream& in) : inStream(in) {
        ptr = 0;
        length = 0;
    }

    int nextChar() {
        if (length == -1) throw runtime_error("EOF");
        if (ptr >= length) {
            ptr = 0;
            inStream.read(buffer, sizeof(buffer));
            length = inStream.gcount();
            if (length <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[ptr++] & 0xff;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int c;
        while ((c = nextChar()) <= ' ') if (c == -1) throw runtime_error("EOF");
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') { sign = -1; c = nextChar(); }
        int value = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("Invalid number");
            value = value * 10 + c - '0';
            c = nextChar();
        } while (c > ' ');
        return value * sign;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    vector<int> basePoly(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        basePoly[in.nextInt()] = 1;
    }

    vector<int> resultPoly = {1};
    int power = n / 2;
    while (power > 0) {
        if ((power & 1) == 1) {
            resultPoly = multiply(resultPoly, basePoly, MOD);
        }
        basePoly = multiply(basePoly, basePoly, MOD);
        power >>= 1;
    }

    long long total = 0;
    for (int coeff : resultPoly) {
        total = (total + (long long)coeff * coeff) % MOD;
    }
    cout << total << endl;
    return 0;
}
